fusions.name: Nip and Skitter
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Gnaw Through
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to a blow that deals 18 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Skirting Board
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you 70% later, you move 15% faster while it lasts, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Quiet Feet
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
